dialogues.speaker: Royinjan
dialogues.text: *sigh* The Dendro Archon will always be our greatest god. The Akademiya's conduct up till now has been simply disgraceful.

dialogues.speaker: Royinjan
dialogues.text: She defended us from such calamities and left us an inexhaustible store of wisdom and treasure...

dialogues.speaker: Royinjan
dialogues.text: So, usually, when I see an antique related to her, I will do my best to buy it and add it to my collection.
